summary: The note describes the Esztergom Basilica, formally the Primatial Basilica of the Blessed Virgin Mary Assumed Into Heaven and St Adalbert, in Esztergom, Hungary. It is an ecclesiastical basilica that serves as the mother church of the Archdiocese of Esztergom-Budapest and as the seat of the Catholic Church in Hungary. The basilica is dedicated to Saint Mary of the Assumption and Saint Adalbert.
one_line: The Esztergom Basilica is the primatial mother church of the Archdiocese of Esztergom-Budapest and the seat of the Catholic Church in Hungary.
